// diagnostic E3006

Jet.Deadlock

Tasks wait on each other

What

Tasks wait on each other

Why

Each task of the cycle waits for the next one: to join it, to edit a Shared value it holds, or to receive on a channel only it can send on. The main task is one of them, so the program could never finish. The `-->` line is where the main task waits; each line below names a task, what it waits for and where.

Fix

Break the cycle: send before you receive, join a task only after the values it waits for are sent, or give one wait a deadline or a `select` with another way out.

Worked example
